title: FlameSMP
description: Welcome to the official Discord for FlameSMP Server! Come join us for duels, FFA PvP, survival, and more!
body: Come explore new content and meet other players of the FlameSMP Minecraft network! Choose from dozens of different Duels modes, including 1v1's, teams (2-5), and FFA with all sorts of different kits! Prefer more of a grind? Climb your way to the top on our Survival server by building your farm empire and raiding other bases!
